The recovered NMC622 showed a discharge capacity of 158.0 mAh/g after 40 cycles at a charge/discharge rate of C/3. 

This capacity was 100.9% of the reversible discharge capacity after 40 cycles, which implies that the baseline capacity was 158.0 mAh/g / 1.009 = 156.6 mAh/g.
